events.title: Adam Lenhart, carillon
events.summary: Experience a live carillon recital featuring graduate student Adam Lenhart at the historic Burton Memorial Tower. This unique musical performance showcases the Charles Baird Carillon's 53 bronze bells, offering a rare opportunity to hear this impressive instrument and engage with the carillonist.

evidence.description: Graduate student Adam Lenhart performs on the Charles Baird Carillon, an instrument of 53 bronze bells located inside the Burton Memorial Tower.

events.title: Annual Día de Los Muertos Community Altar
events.summary: Experience a community altar opening for Día de Los Muertos, featuring submitted photographs of loved ones. The event includes DDLM-themed raffles and goodie bags for early attendees, celebrating culture and remembrance through art and shared experience.
events.registration: Submit photographs of your loved one(s) by Sunday, October 25th.

events.title: Biomedical Engineering (BME 500) Seminar Series
events.summary: This seminar explores the "inflammation-on-a-chip" microphysiological system, a novel approach to studying immune responses. The research investigates cell-cell interactions, focusing on critical signaling between myeloid cells, neutrophils, and the vascular endothelium, offering insights into chronic inflammation and disease.

evidence.description: In this seminar, I will present our research investigating cell-cell interactions using our “inflammation-on-a-chip” microphysiological system with a focus on critical signaling between myeloid cells, neutrophils, and the vascular endothelium.
